description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 As a Product Development Engineer in the Media Health team, you will connect various engineering groups and specialties. You will combine diverse expertise to develop new and improved test strategies, features, and technologies. This role offers an outstanding opportunity to work with the newest technology, helping to build the future of memory and storage solutions.

 You will have or develop guide capability with Probe, and/or ATE test code and testing techniques used to validate and ensure device performance. You will assist in debugging code and aiding other specialists in the characterization of applicable HBM devices. In this role, your additional responsibilities include an in-depth understanding of general device functionality specific to HBM products as well as schematics and signal integrity.

 Responsibilities:

 Collaborate with Design Engineering (DE) to conduct pre-silicon simulations to validate test strategies and circuits for Test. Provide feedback to DE, Test Engineering (TE), and others in Product Engineering (PE).
 Support pre-silicon checklist tasks and collaborate with TE to identify vital tester resources.
 Collaborate with TE and PE to adjust test programs for particular product needs to guarantee that silicon performance aligns with expectations.
 Support TE by aiding in test program debug, data analysis, and test development using AI assistants.
 Assist fabrication sites and process integration with test creation to improve effective process feedback.
 Debug and identify root causes for failures using test and experimental data, and electrical and physical analysis results. Use these results to modify existing testing strategies to improve product quality and enhance yield.
 Supervise yields to ensure they are meeting projections and expeditiously investigate root causes when they are not.
 Provide technical training and expertise, including on-the-job training for new engineers, assisting with data interpretation, acting as a product-specific point of contact, and attending technical seminars.
 Support the local team by building AI-powered tools crafted to advance processes and develop innovative, optimized test strategies and features.
 
 Minimum Qualifications:

 Master's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field and proven experience in a similar product engineering role.
 Education or experience in building Digital circuits, ASIC testing using scan tools, Python, and C programming.
 Custom BIST APG programming for memory testing.
 Experience with Linux operating system.
 Engage in hands-on bench testing of product to uncover issues and formulate tests.
 
 Preferred Qualifications:

 High volume production data extraction and analysis using JMP and/or python.
 Provide assistance to fabrication sites and process integration through the creation of tests aimed at improving effective process feedback.
 Hands on bench testing of engineering hardware and Coordinated Circuits.
 Experience in Circuit simulations using spice and Verilog.
 Knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication process.
 
 
 As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on micron.com/careers/benefits .
